_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under MPL-2.0, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The licence is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/blob/main/LICENSE
release_notes_justification: Human-readable release notes per version are kept in https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md; it covers the latest release, v0.5.4.
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository and its release downloads, https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad; the project website, https://registry.terraform.io/providers/netresearch/ad/latest.
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, for example v0.5.4: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/tags
version_tags_justification: Every release is tagged in git: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/tags
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version number, recorded as a git tag, for example v0.5.4: https://github.com/netresearch/terraform-provider-ad/tags
